I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was the **Southgate** depot. That was the only depot the channel named.

On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel's depots, in the plural. She said Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4, and later that Southgate had cleared the backlog. Before reading the channel, I checked that Tobias is a member.
